Andhra Pradesh recorded a decline in cases in 2025, but Chittoor saw a rise while Anantapur and Kurnool recorded falls. With 5,408 cases pending in exclusive POCSO courts, forensic delays, staff shortages, stigma and fear continue to test the promise of speedy justice, while experts stress prevention, early reporting and stronger child-protection systems.

title: Donald Bren helped protect 57,500 acres of California’s historic Irvine Ranch
description: Billionaire real-estate developer Donald Bren transformed a significant part of the historic Irvine Ranch into protected public lands. After becoming chairman of the Irvine Company, he spearheaded major conservation milestones over the years. The Irvine Ranch now has over 57,000 acres preserved, providing habitats for diverse wildlife. In 2005, the Irvine Ranch Conservancy was established to ensure the ongoing care of these protected areas.

As ERADAL evaluates the property for restoration amid legal challenges, doubts linger over Telerico's financing options to reclaim his estate.

The US government suspended the PERM programme as part of a crackdown on skilled-worker immigration.

Hailing from Madhya Pradesh, Shyam pioneered a unique art form known as Jangarh Kalam, celebrating Gond cultural traditions. Despite experiencing struggles as an indigenous artist, he achieved global recognition before his tragic death by suicide in 2001 in Japan.

She felt unsafe in her train compartment due to inebriated men surrounding her and reached out to her family. Contact was lost between 2:30am and 3:00am, prompting her family to alert the railway authorities. Her body was later discovered near railway tracks in Andhra Pradesh’s Srikakulam district.

Abhishek Sharma on the cusp of breaking Suryakumar Yadav’s unique T20I record
description: Abhishek Sharma is on the brink of achieving a remarkable milestone, needing just 53 runs to cross 2,000 T20I runs during the second T20I against West Indies. With a chance to eclipse Suryakumar Yadav's record for the fastest attainment of this feat, Sharma's current high strike rate demonstrates his game-changing prowess.

title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Israel to honour Capt Smit with top civilian bravery award
description: Israel has announced that Captain Smit Machchhar will receive a prestigious Presidential Award for his bravery. He prevented a potential aviation disaster aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 by acting decisively against a radicalized co-pilot. During the incident, six Israeli passengers displayed great courage in assisting Machchhar and foiling the hijack attempt. This heroic act has led to a broader investigation into the circumstances of the attack.

title: Swift, Kelce called 'absentee' owners over $5.35M Ohio mansion plan
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are facing objections from neighbours over security fencing and landscaping at their $5.35 million Ohio mansion. Residents have raised concerns about a shared sewer line, wildlife safety and privacy. The couple’s representatives say they scaled back the fence and preserved neighbour access, while the board requested revisions to shoreline tree plans.

title: Non-cyclist CEO rides 2,000 miles in 12 days, raises $766K for 70 causes
description: Matt King, CEO of Gobundance, trained for five and a half months before cycling nearly 2,000 miles from Mexico to Canada in 12 days. Along the journey, King and his team raised more than $766,000 and distributed funds to over 70 individuals and organisations, supporting families and communities facing financial hardships.

title: Starlink entry row: Is Ambani the real boss of India, asks Elon Musk
description: Elon Musk has raised concerns about regulatory obstacles facing Starlink's introduction in India. He claimed influential figures might be hindering the process and questioned if Ambani controls the situation. In response, India's government reaffirmed its fair and non-discriminatory approach, rejecting Musk's allegations. Other companies like Reliance Jio and Eutelsat OneWeb are also vying for approval to offer satellite services.

title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers, eases refund rules
description: The GST Council has proposed major procedural changes to enhance business operations and tax compliance. These reforms aim to streamline registration, refunds, and input tax credit processes while lowering compliance costs. Additionally, the council will remove officers' powers for arrests under the GST framework. Processing of refunds will be expedited, with a goal to resolve claims within three days.

title: IAF celebrates its 94-year-old glorious journey
description: Indian Air Force celebrated its 94th anniversary at Hindon Air Force Station showcasing its historical significance. The event featured aerobatics by the vintage Tiger Moth and a display of military aircraft. IAF Chief ACM Singh emphasized the importance of operational preparedness and joint operations with the Army and Navy. PM Narendra Modi and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended the courage and dedication of IAF personnel.

title: Ontario man wins OHIP battle for US cancer therapy
description: Ontario man Alex Shved, who has Stage 4 melanoma, challenged OHIP after it denied funding for TIL therapy in Florida costing about US$600,000. A court ordered the province to reconsider his request. OHIP later rejected it again, while Ontario changed regulations governing out-of-country drug funding, limiting when patients can receive public coverage abroad.

title: Arkansas family wins $12,000 after neighbours removed old fence and trees
description: A recent ruling upheld the Bowlin family's claim regarding a fence that served as a property boundary since 1967. This decision followed a dispute over the removal of the fence and trees by neighboring property owners. The Arkansas Court of Appeals affirmed damages of $12,000 due to intentional tree removal and ordered the reconstruction of the fence.

title: Branson bought $6m island for $100k to impress girl, now worth millions
description: Richard Branson was 29 when he pursued an island to impress Joan Templeman, offering $100,000 for a property priced at $6 million before eventually buying it for $180,000. In 2007, he purchased 125-acre Moskito Island for $15 million. Today, the island has been divided among nine private families who own estates there.

title: ‘Krantiveer’ in life, ‘Natsamrat’ on screen: Nana dies at 75
description: Nana Patekar, a renowned actor from Maharashtra, passed away unexpectedly from a heart attack in Goa. He was known for his powerful performances in both Hindi and Marathi cinema, spanning nearly five decades. Patekar had a notable impact on Indian cinema, often portraying characters that were unpredictable and emotionally complex. He championed various social causes, including rural distress through his NAAM Foundation.

title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say
description: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.

title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell
description: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.

title: TN villagers say they were forced to fall at feet of dominant caste
description: The community of Perumpalli witnessed blatant discrimination against Dalits seeking to bury their deceased, Senni, in a shared burial ground. As the family attempted to claim the space, Rithuvarman and other non-Dalits impeded their efforts. In a striking moment, two Dalits resorted to begging on their knees for permission. Ultimately, police presence facilitated the burial, preventing further conflict and allowing the family to grieve.

title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea
description: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.

title: India's GDP is booming, but stock market is crashing: What's going wrong?
description: India is experiencing impressive GDP growth of 7.8%, while the World Bank revises its growth outlook to 7.1%. Yet, Dalal Street faces turbulence as benchmark indices suffer losses exceeding 1%. This is largely due to foreign investors offloading shares and rising bond yields globally, fostering a cautious sentiment in the market.

title: iPhone burst in pocket, injured thumb; court orders Apple to replace it, pay Rs 36,139
description: A district consumer commission in Uttar Pradesh found Apple India liable for a defective iPhone incident. The phone burst in a consumer’s pocket, injuring his thumb and damaging his personal photos. Following medical treatment, the commission ordered compensation for the consumer’s treatment expenses and directed a refund or replacement. Apple and the local seller failed to dispute the claims presented during the hearings.

title: Dr Phil’s Beverly Hills mansion bought for $29.8m now lists for $67.5m
description: Dr. Phil and his wife Robin McGraw are parting ways with their opulent Beverly Hills estate, listed for a staggering $67.5 million. Acquired for $29.8 million in 2010, the couple undertook extensive renovations, culminating in a dream home featuring eight luxurious bedrooms, a swimming pool, and a guesthouse. This significant increase in value mirrors the thriving real estate market trends in the prestigious Beverly Hills neighborhood.

title: Mumbai CEO marks birthday with 90-hour fast, says he felt stronger
description: Abhishek Agarwal, a Mumbai-based CEO, completed a 90-hour fast to celebrate his birthday. This personal challenge was aimed at pushing his limits and testing his discipline. The experience transitioned from a physical test to a mental one as the days progressed. Responses to his LinkedIn post ranged from admiration to caution about prolonged fasting. The conversation sparked online includes reflections on personal limits and endurance.

title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.

title: Jaipur couple started with rented cows; now runs Rs 2.4 crore sustainable farm
description: Founded in 2018 by Vibhor Jain and Ishita Jain, Kinaya Organic Farms began with a handful of Gir cows. Fast forward to today, they operate a flourishing farm with 100 cows, branching into a variety of dairy products and agroforestry practices. Their sustainable approach incorporates cow dung biogas, rainwater management, and solar energy, ensuring a self-sufficient model that yields impressive annual profits while promoting environmental stewardship.
